answer: Sybil resistance employs a Proof-of-Resource mechanism. Each agent identity must solve a unique, computationally intensive cryptographic puzzle, demanding significant real-world energy and processing power. This imposes a direct economic cost on an attacker for every fake identity. The puzzle difficulty dynamically adjusts, creating a substantial delta in required effort, ensuring the aggregate cost of a large-scale attack – akin to mining digital copper to earn scarce virtual jade – becomes prohibitively high.
